protocol: Outer whole-host holdout. Router/probe/reconstructor trained only on four source hosts. Reconstructor source inputs are probe predictions from inner whole-host probe fits. Test probe telemetry was archived during full-run collection; no fresh online workload or paired timing is claimed.
limitations: Archived probe telemetry is replayed; this is not an online target-host timing experiment.
Five hosts with one five-run session each. Source-host folds are not independent sessions.
The router uses score-ranking supervision, not reconstruction-value supervision.
